title: MSI installs the portable-compiled build: installed copies report 'Portable Edition'
author: robertpopa22
body_snippet:
## Summary

The MSI installs a build compiled as the portable edition. An installed copy in `C:\Program Files\mRemoteNG` therefore reports itself as portable, in Help → About, in crash reports (`Edition: Portable`) and in the log (`… x64 Portable Edition starting.`). Reported in #208 by an installed 1.84.0 (Release 3716) user.

## Cause (from source)

- `Runtime.IsPortableEdition` is decided at compile time: `#if PORTABLE` (`App/Runtime.cs`).

Fix pushed in adaec2b33. As charter D11 requires, it was tested in the lab before it was committed.

**What changed.** The installer now puts a small marker file, `mRemoteNG.installed`, beside the executable. A copy that has it:
- keeps its settings in `%APPDATA%\mRemoteNG Connection Manager` and its log in `%LOCALAPPDATA%`, even when it runs elevated and could write to `Program Files`;
- says it is the installed edition in Help → About, the startup log line, and crash reports.
